title: Yehudah ben Patora
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He and Elazar ben Patora were wicked men in the time of Yochanan the High Priest who seized terumah by force, as related at the end of [Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maaser_Sheni.5.5.18). In [Kiddushin 66a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.66a.9-12),
Elazar is mentioned disparagingly under the name Elazar ben Poira instead of Patora.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Yerushalmi names Elazar ben Pechorah and Yehudah ben Petirah in a discussion of taking the tithes by force. The linked Bavli names Elazar ben Poira in the Yannai narrative. Hyman uses Patora and describes the produce as terumah.
